description:
All roads lead to fun with the Vortex F4 folding scooter. This kick scooter features a compact folding frame, Max Grip deck and brake, wide handlebar with durable bike-style grips, and quick-release adjustable height complete with three lock-in pins. Experience the fun, convenience, and performance of the Vortex F4!
Kick scooter with easy folding design for compact storage and transportation.
Full coverage MaxGrip™ deck and brake provides non-slip contact.
Quick-release adjustable height with three lock-in points can fit a wide range of riders.
Wide handlebars with durable bike style grips for comfortable handling.
Kickstand lets you park the scooter upright, protecting the grips and frame from damage.
180 mm wheels with ABEC – 7 bearings for a smooth ride.
